entry.title: Introduction
entry.content:
Greetings! 👋🏻 Welcome to my homepage.

About me

I am currently an undergraduate student in Data Science and Big Data Technology at Jilin International Studies University (expected to graduate in June 2026).

My research interests focus on Machine Learning Applications, Multimodal Analysis, and the Applications of Large Language Models.

    B.E. in Data Science and Big Data Technology, from September 2022 to June 2026.

    • English: IELTS 6.0; CET-6 (468)
